# Chicago Black Culture (CultureTechLens)

 > 199 Black Chicago places — churches (62), clubs (48), venues (45), theaters (32), banks (12) — reconciled from two October 2026 builds (a 183-row graph union file and a 124-row editorial seed; 108 joined on exact normalized name, full merge log published). Grades were base-mapped from a legacy vocabulary (STRONG EVIDENCE → Supported) with source text preserved and the lowest grade taken where builds disagreed; nothing was upgraded. No coordinates are included and no map is claimed. The FAQ layer was generated mechanically from row fields on 2026-11-16 and is labeled as generated.

## Examples
- **Binga Bank (Binga State Bank)** (Bank) — Chicago's first Black-owned bank: founded as a private bank by Jesse Binga in 1908 (drawing $200,000+ in deposits on opening day)
